label: sec:mass-predictions-derivations-terminal-resolution-proof-preamble
html:
Continuation of the preceding sub-section.

This sub-section specialises the methodology to per-particle derivations. The terminal-resolution proof closes the mass prediction at the per-particle level. The terminal-resolution parameter c_z pins the chirality-dependent constant. Finally, the W-boson mass discrepancy analysis assembles the most precise substrate-level mass prediction and evaluates its empirical gap against PDG values.
